scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared && tsc -p server && tsc -p web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.vercel-build: npm run db:migrate && npm run build -w web && npm run vercel:output -w server
